blocks.raw: # Channel Manager - Reports
blocks.text: Channel Manager - Reports

blocks.raw: ## Reporting
blocks.text: Reporting

blocks.raw: As a related party to Modulr's Travel customers, there are also some bespoke reports that we have created for you to better reconcile between yourselves and the OTA's that you work with, these are:
blocks.text: As a related party to Modulr's Travel customers, there are also some bespoke reports that we have created for you to better reconcile between yourselves and the OTA's that you work with, these are:

blocks.raw: **Channel Manager Card Management Report**
blocks.text: Channel Manager Card Management Report

blocks.raw: The Channel Manager Card Management Report details out the specific movements of card statuses as well as detail out the custom fields related to the cards
blocks.text: The Channel Manager Card Management Report details out the specific movements of card statuses as well as detail out the custom fields related to the cards

blocks.raw: You will be able to filter by a specific Card ID so that you can see when it was created, when it was cancelled and the custom field information relating to it.
blocks.text: You will be able to filter by a specific Card ID so that you can see when it was created, when it was cancelled and the custom field information relating to it.

blocks.raw: **Channel Manager Card Activities Report**
blocks.text: Channel Manager Card Activities Report

blocks.raw: The Channel Manager Card Activities Report will outline the cards that have been created and the related activities that have been completed on each card
blocks.text: The Channel Manager Card Activities Report will outline the cards that have been created and the related activities that have been completed on each card

blocks.raw: You will be able to locate a specific card and see the authorisation and the settlement detail for the activities on that card as well as if there have been any other movements such as refunds
blocks.text: You will be able to locate a specific card and see the authorisation and the settlement detail for the activities on that card as well as if there have been any other movements such as refunds

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Frequency Of Reports
>
> Both of these reports will be available in a daily or monthly CSV files file you to pull directly from the API endpoints
>
> These will always need to be pulled from the API and will not automatically be pushed to you
blocks.text: Frequency Of ReportsBoth of these reports will be available in a daily or monthly CSV files file you to pull directly from the API endpointsThese will always need to be pulled from the API and will not automatically be pushed to you

blocks.raw: ## Getting Started With Reports
blocks.text: Getting Started With Reports

blocks.raw: To obtain what reports are available to you each day / month you will need to first call [GET/channel-managers/card-reports](https://modulr.readme.io/reference/channelmanagersearchcardreports) which will return back a list of the report ID’s that are available to you.
blocks.text: To obtain what reports are available to you each day / month you will need to first call GET/channel-managers/card-reports which will return back a list of the report ID’s that are available to you.

blocks.raw: When using this endpoint you will need to enter some search criteria, options are:
blocks.text: When using this endpoint you will need to enter some search criteria, options are:

blocks.raw: **Date** – The From and To dates of the reports you are looking for
blocks.text: Date – The From and To dates of the reports you are looking for

blocks.raw: **Report type** – This will be the name of the specific report (listed above)
blocks.text: Report type – This will be the name of the specific report (listed above)

blocks.raw: **Report Subject ID** – This will be your Channel Manager ID
blocks.text: Report Subject ID – This will be your Channel Manager ID

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Best Practice
>
> Its best practice to always include your Channel Manager ID
blocks.text: Best PracticeIts best practice to always include your Channel Manager ID

target.note: theme/icon -> kind; drop the emoji, Documentation.AI draws its own

blocks.raw: Once you have a list of the report ID’s then you will need to send a further call to [GET/channel-managers/card-reports/\{id}/report](https://modulr.readme.io/reference/channelmanagerretrievereport) to get back the CSV file of that specific report
blocks.text: Once you have a list of the report ID’s then you will need to send a further call to GET/channel-managers/card-reports/{id}/report to get back the CSV file of that specific report

blocks.raw:
> 📘 No Longer Working With OTA
>
> In the event that you are no longer working with a specific OTA anymore you will still be able to get details back on cards that you have created for them
